stem.text: A lift (elevator) consists of a passenger car supported by a cable that runs over a light, frictionless pulley to a counterbalance. The counterbalance falls as the passenger car rises.

stem.alt: Pulley with a cable running to a counterbalance on one side and a passenger car with a passenger inside on the other, labelled not to scale

stem.text: Some masses are shown in the table.
What is the magnitude of the acceleration of the car when carrying just one passenger and when the pulley is free to rotate?
